comment: v580 feast-type exception table. Keys are observance names as the devotional calendar carries them (matched normalized: case-folded, leading 'The ' dropped, trailing descriptors after a comma cut). The classifier (jobs/publish/feast_classification.py) consults calendar metadata and its deterministic patterns first; this table settles the feasts those cannot. events: no invocation (a Marian event adds nothing — Mary stands first in the litany). persons: an event-form title that yields its named person. dedications: a dedication feast that yields its associated person(s) (John's rule, 2026-11-21).
